limitations: Small synthetic text-level comparison; not a real-PDF OCR benchmark or proof of general superiority.
Incorrect extra values are false positives in explicitly evaluated fields, not necessarily invented literal values.
Layout scoring reuses Worker validation; it does not execute the full Python table resolver.
Prompts are captured unchanged; model-specific parameter adaptations must be recorded in each run.parameters.
